case.query: How often should I expect to see my doctor for prenatal visits during the last month of my pregnancy?
evidence: Usually, visits during your pregnancy occur: Once a month for weeks 4 through 28 Twice a month for weeks 28 through 36 Weekly for week 36 until your baby is born If you are over 35 years old or your pregnancy is high risk because of health problems like diabetes or high blood pressure , your provider will probably want to see you more often.
